paper: Paper VI - Orion Scientific Research Engine
authority: Same-context analysis. No scientific or promotion authority.
object: The capstone scientific question after Self-RAKL 044, the external-agent programme, and the evaluator-integrity incident.
previous_recommended_question: What does each layer contribute, and at what cost?
why_that_is_still_needed_but_no_longer_s: Layer contribution/cost is the correct noncompensatory metrology table but does not by itself distinguish Orion from 2026 self-evolving skill/agent systems.
EvoSkill already uses failure analysis, held-out validation and Pareto frontier selection for skill evolution.
SkillFoundry already builds and iteratively validates/repairs/merges/prunes scoped scientific skills with provenance and tests.
Red Queen Godel Machine explicitly makes evaluator evolution part of recursive self-improvement while freezing evaluation within an epoch.
RAKL now has its own concrete evaluator chronology incident (#710), so evaluator governance is an observed engineering/scientific problem rather than a hypothetical concern.

candidate_questions.question: What does each evidence-governed engine layer contribute, and at what total cost?
candidate_questions.why: Retain as the per-layer ledger/ablation table and prerequisite for attribution.

candidate_questions.question: Can Orion expand its validated capability frontier by diagnosing a real weakness, assimilating or inventing a mechanic change, and demonstrating a fresh scoped improvement without weakening protected validity/cost coordinates?
candidate_questions.why: A competitor win, null transfer or successful assimilation are all interpretable terminals; no hero-positive is required.

candidate_questions.question: Can recursive improvement remain trustworthy when evaluator/benchmark/meta-policy are themselves mutable, by enforcing a fixed content-bound evaluator inside each evidence epoch and requiring a separate outer-assurance epoch for evaluator changes?
candidate_questions.why: Prevents self-evolution from changing the ruler while claiming to have grown; directly exercises the higher-order surfaces in Self-RAKL 044.

candidate_questions.question: Can Orion distinguish agent failure from evaluator/benchmark failure before using an external benchmark as evolution evidence?
candidate_questions.why: BenchGuard-class results and the repo's own instrument-negative history show benchmark defects can dominate conclusions.

candidate_questions.question: When may success of a mutation operator in one fibre/layer update its prior elsewhere?
candidate_questions.why: Global mutation credit can create negative transfer; cross-context credit should require explicit evidence/transport.

recommended_headline_question.statement: Can an evidence-governed research engine recursively improve its own method frontier while preserving the integrity of the evaluator that authorizes each improvement? Concretely: freeze an audited evaluator epoch, measure the incumbent against strong internal/external parents, diagnose a weakness, build one governed challenger, and require fresh improvement under the still-frozen evaluator; evaluator/meta-policy changes must themselves enter only through a separately frozen outer-assurance epoch.
recommended_headline_question.paper_title_direction: Orion: Evaluator-Governed Recursive Self-Improvement for Scientific Research
recommended_headline_question.why_better: It makes the assembled system do something only the capstone can demonstrate: recursively change itself while keeping evidence/authority chronology intact. The layer contribution/cost table, external-agent frontier and negative-history ledger become the instruments that make the claim auditable.

epoch_0_instrument: audit benchmark/evaluator artifacts before system outcomes
record known limitations and planted controls
epoch_1_incumbent: run incumbent and strongest internal/external parents
preserve baseline-only wins and Orion harms
freeze weakness map and diagnosis state before designing repair
mutation_development: if diagnosis is DISCRIMINATOR_REQUIRED, run discriminator before mutation
epoch_2_fresh_assurance: evaluate incumbent/challenger/parent on disjoint tasks under unchanged evaluator identity
one full-system positive cannot promote failed components
evaluator_change_rule: an evaluator candidate never certifies itself
change requires content-bound outer evaluator/benchmark identity frozen before candidate outcomes
new evaluator defines a new epoch
replay stable anchors to measure evaluator drift before using new epoch for future credit

meta_evolution_v2_repairs: replace outer_assurance_frozen boolean with identity/chronology binding
scope mutation credit by operator + layer + fibre/context
escalate on distinct failed mutation families/evidence epochs rather than raw attempts

publication_branching.external_parent_wins: Strong negative/diagnostic capstone: preserve the loss and attempt assimilation only after weakness freeze.
publication_branching.challenger_development_only: No recursive improvement claim; report method candidate and blocked fresh assurance.
publication_branching.challenger_fresh_positive: Scoped self-evolution evidence if evaluator and authority chronology remain clean.
publication_branching.evaluator_change_needed: Do not compare across the boundary as one continuous score; close epoch and establish a new outer-assured evaluator epoch.
publication_branching.benchmark_defect_found: Benchmark audit is the result for that instrument; repair/version it before agent comparison, preserving the invalid epoch.

must_not_claim: Independent assurance from a panel of same-context LLM reviewers.
Architecture causality from native external-system comparisons with different models/tools/resources.
Self-improvement when the evaluator changed after candidate outcome access.
Component efficacy because the integrated engine won.
Global mutation-operator transfer from one successful fibre.
